scope: Synthetic Rex fixture checks, not Chartr verification. All mutations use a dedicated Unix socket, state directory and empty Lua configuration.

corrections.cause: A JSON command exceeded canonical PTY input line length. Disabled ICANON in the synthetic fixture and reran. This was a harness failure, not a Rex product failure.
Assertion incorrectly looked for content in blob_read; actual schema uses data. supplement-results.json reassembled every chunk and matched the full capture byte for byte.

limits: Server API behavior only for listed checks.
No remote host, multi-client contention, real provider outcome matrix, native notification delivery, performance benchmark or crash/reboot survival test.
Rex native settings were inspected without changing preferences. Late menu automation returned stale element IDs and screenshot-unavailable errors; no activity-overview interaction is claimed.
Chartr was source-reviewed, not built or launched by this analysis.
